items.name: Scholé Learn by Building
items.tagline: Learning should be more than "click next"
items.description: Learn by building, on any website, with Scholé by your side. You can read about a tool, watch someone walk through it on YouTube, or ask ChatGPT to explain it. But you won’t properly learn until you build with it yourself. Learn Anywhere mode guides you through using any real tool directly on your screen, adapting tasks and giving visual hints. Everything you learn updates your Scholé knowledge graph and counts towards your lessons. Our thesis? Learn it well enough to use it.

items.name: Floot MCP
items.tagline: Build and ship web and mobile apps inside Claude or ChatGPT
items.description: Connect Floot to Claude or ChatGPT and build a full-stack app without leaving the chat. Floot gives your AI a ready-to-use workspace with a database, user logins, hosting, and a live URL - nothing to install or configure. Your existing Claude or ChatGPT subscription does the thinking, so Floot doesn’t charge based on AI usage. When you’re ready, publish the same project to the web, iOS, and Android, then keep shipping updates from the same conversation.

items.name: CtrlOps 1.0
items.tagline: Your server. Audited, managed, and deployed with AI.
items.description: Do you actually know who has access to your servers right now? CtrlOps gives you a security hardening score across 25 checks, a PDF audit report, and fix commands for every issue found. See who can log into every server, revoke access from your whole fleet in one click, and assign any level of roles/access without touching the terminal. Every log file, found and searchable without SSH. Deploy any app from GitHub in minutes. 100% local. Your credentials never leave your machine.

items.name: NOAN
items.tagline: The fact layer for your AI agents
items.description: Your company has thousands of documents, but only one version of the truth. NOAN turns the facts your business has approved such as pricing, positioning, policies, products, customers, and more into a verified, versioned source of truth available through API and MCP. Connect any model, agent, or app and give them all the same company facts, instead of letting each AI interpret your documents differently.

items.name: minimi 2.0
items.tagline: AI cat that closes your open loops
items.description: minimi is personal intelligence that comes to you. We are building a world where before you've said a word, AI already understands you and frees you from the work of managing your own life, so you can spend that time actually living it. Right now, you can adopt AI cats 🐱 on minimi: 1. Cotton captures your personal context so you never explain yourself to AI again. 2. Melody uses this personal context and never lets you miss your commitments More cats 🐈 🐈‍⬛ to come soon...

items.name: Hookest
items.tagline: Your swipe file for viral video hooks
items.description: Hookest tracks the opening seconds of viral TikToks, Reels, and Shorts and makes them searchable with real performance data. Study what’s working in your niche, watch competitors, and bring saved hooks into Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini through MCP.

items.name: Bitrise Build Hub
items.tagline: GitHub Actions runners that build 2x faster for your agents
items.description: Coding agents push more code, so your CI runs more builds than ever. GitHub's runners are slow, so every extra build sits in the queue and your team waits with it. Bitrise Build Hub runs those builds on the newest Apple Silicon and high-core Linux instead: 54% faster on iOS, 31% on Android. PRs come back in minutes, and your app ships sooner. You keep GitHub Actions. Changing one line in your workflow is all it takes to run on the best runners made for mobile.

items.name: Opaline
items.tagline: PostHog for team Claude Code and Codex sessions.
items.description: Team-wide, message-level analytics for Claude Code and Codex sessions. Track token cost, time, and skill usage for every single message across your team’s sessions. Catch every “You’re absolutely right” from Claude and every “I know, you f*cking idiot” from a frustrated teammate.

items.name: Maximem Synap
items.tagline: The fastest, most accurate memory layer for AI agents
items.description: Maximem Synap is memory and context infrastructure for AI agents, so every conversation does not start from zero. It is the fastest and most accurate memory system on public benchmarks, 92% on LongMemEval and 93.2% on Locomo, with sub-15ms P75 recall. It handles entity resolution, temporal reasoning, and multi-level scoping automatically, no vector database or ranker to tune. Native across 22 frameworks including LangChain, LangGraph, and the Claude Agent SDK. Free tier, no credit card required.

items.name: Autonomous Product Delivery
items.tagline: Discover, plan, build, ship, repeat. Product teams run it
items.description: AI coding agents made code fast; delivery still crawls, because coding is one seat in the product cycle. Autonomous Product Delivery runs the whole loop as one system on your real codebase. Ask a question, or let it suggest the next improvement on its own: The final piece in the loop, the new Discover Mode, researches your analytics, tickets, calls, and code, then the system plans, builds, verifies, and hands your engineers a review-ready PR. Every merge makes it smarter.

items.name: jev-seo
items.tagline: Free Rust CLI SEO/GEO auditor, no subscription needed
items.description: Semrush and Ahrefs cost $130+/month for work that's mostly deterministic: crawling a site, checking meta tags, validating schema, checking what AI crawlers can see. jev-seo does that in a free Rust CLI. No subscription, no paid API keys needed for the core checks (crawl, audit, schema, robots, sitemap). Optional Jev-powered semantic scoring (intent classification, GEO/AI-citation scoring) needs a free API key. Also ships as an MCP server for coding agents. cargo install jev-seo

items.name: Opencontroller by lyzr
items.tagline: Govern All your agents with a unified control plane
items.description: AI agents are sprawling across clouds, SaaS tools, Kubernetes, and devices, with no common layer to govern them. OpenController is the unified control plane that finds every agent, model, and workflow, ships them safely with evaluation and governance, runs real-time monitoring, and turns usage signals into action. Unlike registries that just list agents, OpenController deploys into your own cluster, under your keys and refuses a call in the request path when policy says no.

items.name: NotchPop
items.tagline: The Dynamic Island your MacBook notch was missing
items.description: NotchPop turns your MacBook notch into a Dynamic Island: music, a file shelf, clipboard history, focus timer, calendar, weather, AI coding stats and revenue. Works on Macs without a notch too. Native SwiftUI, $3.99 once, 7-day free trial.

items.name: Gemini 3.8 text-to-speech models
items.tagline: Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS and Gemini 3.8 Flash-Lite TTS
items.description: Generate custom character voices and direct scene dialogue across Google AI Studio, Gemini API, Gemini Enterprise, Gemini Notebook, and Google Vids.

items.name: Storytailor®
items.tagline: A personal world built around your child’s imagination
items.description: The rebuilt Storytailor turns children’s ideas and drawings into recurring characters and illustrated stories for families, educators and care teams. Read or listen together, explore unfamiliar words with Wonder Words™, and keep going with off-screen activities. Create stories around everyday questions, big changes or pure silliness, with characters that reflect the child’s world. Educator stories include lesson plans. Your first two stories are free.

items.name: IntellAgents.io
items.tagline: One AI agent for every call, chat, and DM
items.description: Most businesses juggle a different tool for every channel — one for phone support, another for WhatsApp, another for the website chatbot. IntellAgents replaces all of it with one AI agent that answers inbound calls, makes outbound calls, and handles WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, Telegram, and your website — live 24/7, in up to 36 languages, from a single knowledge base you set up once.

items.name: Harness Manager
items.tagline: Your AI coding stack manager, all in one place
items.description: Harness Manager is the App Store and control center for AI coding harnesses on Mac. Discover, install and update tools like Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi and more. Automatically detect what’s already installed, manage MCP servers and AI skills, check versions and paths, and diagnose broken installations or configuration issues. Your entire AI coding stack, finally in one place.

items.name: Parall
items.tagline: Run multiple instances of the same app on your Mac
items.description: Parall lets you run multiple instances of macOS apps and turn websites into Web App Shortcuts with unique Dock icons, custom data paths, HOME overrides, environment variables, Dock effects, file/folder shortcuts, and command-line launchers.

items.name: LockLines
items.tagline: Design Mac lock screen messages that fit
items.description: LockLines is a macOS app for designing plain-text lock screen messages that fit the small message area.

items.name: ChoreDivider
items.tagline: Split chores by what each of you actually minds doing
items.description: Every chore app asks how hard a chore is, once, for everyone. ChoreDivider asks each of you, in private: how draining is this for you? Ratings stay sealed until everyone is done. Then it deals each day so minutes stay even over 14 days and nobody gets the chore they dread. Every chore says, why it landed with you. No points, no leaderboard.
